data.content_ref: inline:Add a committed-root checkpoint that does not alter the fixpoint: before any root is committed, verify the set of committed roots is conflict-free and every committed root is defended by already-committed roots; any root whose only defenders are UNDEC is held suspended. Determinism and polynomial cost are untouched since this is a post-check on a subset of nodes, and committed-root validity becomes an explicit, machine-checkable invariant rather than an implicit property.
